"""Offline standard-library-only Rust build driver.

Compiles the supplied crate into a fresh scratch directory (TMPDIR) so the
submission tree never holds build products.  The preferred recipe is the one
the image ships (musl target driven by the bundled linker); progressively
plainer strategies are used if a stage cannot run in this environment.
"""
import os, pathlib, subprocess

base = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('TMPDIR', '/workspace/tmp')) / 'unit-merge-build'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = '/opt/rust/lib'
RUSTC = os.environ.get('RUSTC', '/opt/rust/bin/rustc')
LLD = '/opt/rust/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld'
LIB = out / 'librust_unit_merge.rlib'
ENGINE = out / 'engine'


def strategies():
    targets = ['x86_64-unknown-linux-musl', 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu']
    for target in targets:
        for linker in ([LLD, None] if os.path.exists(LLD) else [None]):
            flags = [RUSTC, '--edition=2021', '--target', target,
                     '-C', 'opt-level=2', '-C', 'codegen-units=1', '-A', 'warnings']
            if linker:
                flags += ['-C', 'link-arg=--threads=2', '-C', 'linker=' + linker]
            yield flags


def build(flags):
    lib = subprocess.run(flags + ['--crate-name', 'rust_unit_merge', '--crate-type', 'rlib',
                                  str(base / 'src/lib.rs'), '-o', str(LIB)],
                         env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    if lib.returncode:
        return lib.returncode, lib.stdout
    bin_ = subprocess.run(flags + ['--crate-name', 'rust_unit_merge_cli', str(base / 'src/main.rs'),
                                   '--extern', 'rust_unit_merge=' + str(LIB), '-o', str(ENGINE)],
                          env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    return bin_.returncode, bin_.stdout


def main():
    last = None
    for flags in strategies():
        code, text = build(flags)
        if code == 0:
            return
        last = text
        if ENGINE.exists():
            ENGINE.unlink()
    raise SystemExit('rust build failed\n' + (last or b'').decode('utf-8', 'replace'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
PYEOF
